title: Got a little carried away making this multiplayer meme game the past few days
author: Important_Luck_3546
selftext:
I saw a lot of similar (presumably) one shots in X but they were so sloppy.

Made with codex(20x) Astra ultra/max and Claude Code(1x) Opus 5.5 XHigh. Astra did most of the work while Opus did polish on graphics and models. Workflow was just chatting and iterating on it. Some stats:

* 215 prompts (72 steering)
* 84% of Codex (20x) weekly
* 60% of the Claude (1x) weekly
* Tokens 1.1B in (98% cached), 4.7M out, about $1,200 at API prices

Stack is Three.js client and a Rust server. Performance test handled 324 concurrent load-test clients with 9 shards at 86% CPU on a VPS with one shared CPU core and 2 GB RAM.

I think the multiplayer is kinda boring ngl, if you have any ideas to spice it up let me know. There are 10 bots in case the lobby is empty.

Playable at [https://jonniek.github.io/flying-car/](https://jonniek.github.io/flying-car/) or [https://jonniek.itch.io/flying-car-simulator](https://jonniek.itch.io/flying-car-simulator)

comments.author: Blake9712
comments.body: Seems like depending on the booster controls it could be pretty fun as a proper racing game. Maybe impact physics would be nice too (light deforming I mean)
